# 🧭 Self-correcting Copilot instructions

Welcome! 👋 You will build automation that turns trusted maintainer corrections into reviewed updates to `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

| | |
|---|---|
| 🎯 **Goal** | Ship a governed correction-to-pull-request pipeline |
| 🧩 **Lessons** | 2 lessons · 10 steps |
| ⏱️ **Time** | 45–60 minutes |
| 🧰 **Toolkit** | GitHub Actions · Node.js 20 · JSON Schema |

**How this issue works**

1. 📖 Read the step posted below.
2. ⌨️ Make the change in your repository.
3. 🚀 Commit and push.
4. 🤖 Automation grades your work and posts the next step, or 🛟 recovery guidance.

> [!TIP]
> Stuck on a step? Every step ends with a **Recovery** section written for exactly that failure.
